clues.text: Before the flood, God ordered it made of gopher wood, with rooms inside and pitch coating it inside and out.
Before the flood, God said it must be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
Before the flood, creatures came to Noah two by two, male and female, to go into it as God commanded.
Jesus said people kept eating, drinking and marrying right up to the day Noah entered it.
Shem, Ham, and Japheth came out of it, and Ham was the father of Canaan.
While floodwaters still covered the earth, a dove found no place to rest her foot and was brought back inside it.
Peter wrote that God waited patiently while it was built, and only eight souls were saved in it through water.
